body:
I like my thieno/benzodiazepines and try to have some every Saturday or two. I'd had diclazepam last year, as a friend gave me three 2mg pills, so I took them at around 20:00 on the Saturday and after 45 minutes I still did not feel anything happening.
I waited till 21:30 and still nothing happened. I'd heard they were mild but I put it down to long-term benzo use. I'd had the odd small use in my late teens, but in my 20s I thrashed them for about 10 years as I could get quality Xanax (alprazolam), loprazolam (Dormonoct), diazepam, nitrazepam, temazepam, midazolam  and triazolam (Halcion); phenobarbital (a very low 30mg of that mild barbiturate mixed with a mild buzz-level of benzos was mental - it got me absolutely s**t-faced!)
This year I hadn't any benzos (short-acting too) for 3 months and did 10mg of diclazepam to see if I got any effect of it. Nothing happened all night. The next night I did I did 2mg of clonazolam and 2mg of etizolam. I was out of it, going in and out of consciousness till 03:00, when I unsteadily had a bowl of cereal and went to bed waking at 05:20 and then 08.40.
In my opinion diclazepam is crap, crap, crap. It's a waste, much like deschloroetizolam.
